name: to-tickets
description: Turn settled work into approved GitHub tracer-bullet tickets with explicit relationships.
adaptations: Use GitHub Issues as the only tracker and remove local-file and non-GitHub tracker branches.
Require explicit user approval of the complete breakdown before any issue write.
Keep parent/sub-issue membership distinct from blocking dependencies.
Represent relationships with native connected GitHub capability first, authenticated REST second, and explicit Markdown references third, never silently dropping an edge.
Do not require configured triage labels.
